user.title: Connect your Tonal
user.description: Sign in with the first account on the trainer. You can add the other people who use it afterwards. Credentials go straight to Tonal's Auth0 servers and are only stored locally, so the integration can renew its session.

error.invalid_auth: Tonal rejected that email and password.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Tonal is already set up. Add more people to it as accounts rather than setting it up again.

user.title: Add an account
user.description: Sign in with another person's Tonal account. They get their own device and their own set of sensors.

reconfigure.title: Sign in again
reconfigure.description: Re-enter the password for {email}. Tonal invalidates a session from time to time, and this is how you restore it.

error.invalid_auth: Tonal rejected that email and password.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: That Tonal account has already been added.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll Tonal. Workout history changes rarely, so there is little reason to go below 15 minutes.
data_description.fetch_titles: Fetches the name of each workout template once and caches it. Turn this off to keep the request count to a minimum.

export_data.name: Export data
export_data.description: Writes one account's Tonal data to a JSON file in the ToneGet export format.

account.name: Account
account.description: Which account to export, by the name shown on its device. Required when more than one account is set up.

file_path.name: File path
file_path.description: Where to write the file. Defaults to a timestamped file in your config directory. Any other location must be in allowlist_external_dirs.

full.name: Full export
full.description: Keep every raw API field instead of trimming the unused ones.
